dashboard.title: Financial reporting
dashboard.subtitle: What was earned, what is owed, and what each activity brought in
dashboard.zakatNotDue: Nothing is due — Zakat is only paid when the business is in profit for the year.
dashboard.oneActivityHint: Every transaction for a single activity over the selected dates, with its own totals sheet.
dashboard.allActivitiesHint: One consolidated sheet totalling each activity side by side, with the VAT return underneath.
dashboard.csvNote: The file mirrors the ZATCA sales-detail layout.
dashboard.workbookNote: One sheet totalling each activity side by side.
dashboard.widen: Widen the date range to see more.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Every card payment as the terminal saw it, whatever fed it in
transactions.sourceNote: The platform does not care where the rows come from — a payment terminal or a nightly extract look identical.

commissions.title: Card commissions
commissions.subtitle: What the acquiring bank withholds on each card scheme, and what it costs the business
commissions.netSettled: Net settled to the bank account
commissions.asExpense: Recorded as an expense, never as tax
commissions.contractHint: From the contract with the acquiring bank. A change applies to everything imported afterwards.
commissions.reprice: Re-price transactions that have not settled yet. Settled money is never rewritten.
commissions.howBookedNote: The amount the bank keeps is a cost of doing business, not a tax. It is posted as a bank commission expense — one entry per day per scheme — so it reduces the taxable base and the net profit the Zakat is calculated on. It never appears as VAT collected or VAT paid.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: What the platform recorded at the counter — the other half of the reconciliation

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: What the terminal saw against what the platform recorded
reconciliation.openRecord: Open the record behind this exception
reconciliation.allMatchHint: The terminal and the platform agree on every transaction.
reconciliation.compared: {{count}} transactions compared. Only what does not line up is listed below.

cards.noRows: No card transactions in this period
cards.noRowsHint: Widen the dates or import a feed.
cards.importHint: An array of objects. externalRef, scheme and grossAmount are required; the rest is optional. Re-importing the same reference is ignored, so a feed can be replayed safely.

manualSales.title: Manual sales
manualSales.subtitle: Revenue taken off-system. It counts for nothing until it is bank-matched and approved.
manualSales.recordBlurb: A paper receipt, a season that ran before the tills were live.
manualSales.descriptionHint: Enough for whoever approves it to recognise the money.
manualSales.amountHint: The amount actually taken, VAT included.
manualSales.occurredHint: The day the money changed hands, not today.
manualSales.reviewBlurb: Approving posts it to revenue. Someone else has to approve an entry you made yourself.
manualSales.noteHint: What it was matched against, or why it is being rejected.
manualSales.emptyMessage: Everything so far went through a till.

refunds.title: Refund approvals
refunds.subtitleApprover: Money waiting for someone who may release it.
refunds.subtitleDesk: What you have asked to give back, and where it got to.
refunds.reviewBlurb: Releasing it moves the money on the original payment method. Nobody releases their own request.
refunds.noteHint: Required when refusing; useful either way.
refunds.emptyMessage: Refunds asked for at a desk appear here for approval.
